latest.text:
Medvedev beat Cobolli 7–6, 6–3 in Turin to end the first appearance of Cobolli at this event, which he played at home.

The first set had no break of serve but Cobolli was the one under pressure. He saved two break points early on, then came back from 0–40 to hold for 4–4. In the tiebreak Medvedev was too solid and took it 7–4 to lead by a set. It was the same story in the second set. He broke midway through and won 4 games in a row to take it 6–3.

All of that rested on his serve. Medvedev did not face a single break point all match. Even his second serve held up, with 69% of the points won against his usual 50%.

All in all, a clean, dominant win from Medvedev, with a dominance ratio of 1.86. It was more one-sided than the score suggests, as Cobolli kept it close only by saving break points. Medvedev believes this surface gives him his best chance against his next opponent: "I think this is the best surface for me to try to beat Alcaraz" Next is Alcaraz.
